# LingYue Tools

> Free, lightweight AI tools for Mac video creators. No subscription, no account required.

## Products

### VoxOver (v1.3.1)

VoxOver is a free, open-source macOS app (Apple Silicon) that:
- Transcribes speech from any video using OpenAI Whisper (runs locally)
- Translates subtitles using one of four AI backends:
  - **Ollama** — fully local, 100% private, no API key needed (supports qwen3, llama3, etc.)
  - **DeepSeek** — cloud API, 50+ languages, very affordable
  - **OpenAI** — GPT-4o/GPT-4, supports custom Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints
  - **Anthropic** — Claude Sonnet/Haiku
- Exports subtitles as SRT, MKV (soft subs), or MP4 (hard-burned)
- Generates a global translation context prompt for consistent terminology
- Translates segments in parallel (configurable worker count)
- Stores Whisper models locally at `~/Library/Application Support/VoxOver/whisper-models`
- License: MIT (free and open source)
- Requirements: macOS with Apple Silicon (arm64), Python 3, ffmpeg
